topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Well, now, ain't that a curious turn of the earth? I reckon the last time I saw the mill turn so swift was when the spring floods swept through. Here you are, thinking your words are as private as the seed I sow, only to find them spread as wide and far as the wind carries the thistledown. It's a fine thing, to have your thoughts shared, I suppose. But surely, the ground wasn't tilled for such a harvest. Must be a strange feeling, seeing your own scribbles held up for all to see. I imagine you'd feel like the first seedling poking its head out in spring—Exposed, aye, but also a bit proud. What say you, what will you do with this sudden sunlight on your words?
